prompt: Implement a p=1 QAOA circuit for MaxCut on the 4-node cycle graph with edges (0,1), (1,2), (2,3), (3,0), using the FIXED parameters gamma = 0.6 and beta = 0.4 (do not optimize or choose different values — the exact final state is only well-defined for these specific angles). Steps: Hadamard on all 4 qubits. Cost layer: for each edge (i,j) in the order (0,1), (1,2), (2,3), (3,0), apply CNOT(i,j), then RZ(2*gamma, j), then CNOT(i,j) again (this implements exp(-i*gamma*Z_i*Z_j)). Mixer layer: apply RX(2*beta) to every qubit. Return the resulting 4-qubit state; no measurement.
